activity_summary: One-handed, on the floor, you fair-copied three lines you had already written on Saturday. You did not add a speech. You did not mend the girl. The rest of the sheet stayed foul. On the tables, nothing.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote three lines one-handed, and set the pen down.

entities.name: the orchard scene
